name: Alternate - Der Fall Okazaki
source: The visual novel approaches the problem from "Switch - Fluch oder Segen" in an alternative time line. Three completely different ways and the choices are in your hands. A battle between Gods and humans. Friends or family? How will you choose?
translation: 本作从另一条时间线探讨《Switch－诅咒还是祝福》中的问题。三条截然不同的道路，选择全部掌握在你手中。诸神与人类之间的战争，朋友还是家人？你会如何选择？
